世界觀系列 03：擔心、直覺，還有身體的累，都有值得聽見的訊息；而做決定的，是此: Worldview series 03: worry, intuition and the tiredness of the body all carry messages worth hearing; and the one who decides is the you of this moment.
方向盤在現在的你手上: the wheel is in your hands, right now
擔心、直覺，還有身體的累，都有值得聽見的訊息；而做決定的，是此時此地的你。: Worry, intuition and the tiredness of the body all carry messages worth hearing; and the one who decides is the you of this moment.
再決定現在怎麼走。: then decide which way to go now.
不必急著聽誰的。: and no need to rush to follow any one of them.
「…協助大家理解怎麼長出這一個治理層，所以會先幫他們拆解原本的人格與聲音還有靈魂: “…to help everyone understand how to grow this steering layer, so I first help them take apart their original personality and voices and the signals the soul wants to convey, and then grow a steering role that stands between the two…”
「…並教會大家如何善用這個角色並能夠穩穩地在地球成為真正的自己…」: “…and teach everyone how to use this role well, and to be able to steadily become their true selves on Earth…”
你可能也有過這樣的時候：心裡同時有好幾個聲音。有的擔心、有的想保護你，有的習慣照: You may have had times like this: several voices at once inside you. Some worry, some want to protect you, some simply do things the way they always have. There may also be one very quiet voice, reminding you of the direction you really want to go.
有時候，身體也會傳來訊息，告訴你累了，或是有些緊繃。: Sometimes the body sends a message too, telling you that you are tired, or a little tense.
我們把這些聲音都聽見之後，仍然能為自己做決定的那個位置，叫做「治理層」。: The place from which we can still make our own decision, after hearing all of these voices, we call the “steering layer”.
它不是要你消除情緒，也不是要哪個聲音閉嘴。每個聲音都可以被聽見，只是不必由其中一: It does not ask you to get rid of emotions, or to make any voice be quiet. Every voice can be heard; it is only that no single voice has to decide everything.
這是我們用來理解自己的一種方式，不是已經被證實的定律。: This is one way we understand ourselves, not a law that has been proven.
三個來源匯到中間的「此時此地的我」。靈魂的訊號：方向、直覺、「這不是我要的」。人: Three sources flow into the “me of now” in the middle. The soul's signals: direction, intuition, “this is not what I want”. The personality's voice: worry, habit, protection. The body's signals: tired, tight, loose. What the “me of now” does: hear everything, judge who should step in now, decide, take responsibility. Below that come action, feedback, adjustment.
判斷現在誰該上場: Judge who should step in now
都有話想告訴你。: all have something to tell you.
在我們的理解裡，人格是為了在地球上生活，慢慢學會的一套適應方式。那些擔心和習慣，: In our understanding, personality is a set of ways of adapting that we slowly learn in order to live on Earth. Those worries and habits are, much of the time, what the you of the past left behind to protect yourself.
靈魂的訊號，比較像一種內在的方向感。有時候很安靜，只是一個「這是我想要的」，或「: The soul's signals are more like an inner sense of direction. Sometimes very quiet, just a feeling of “this is what I want”, or “this is not what I want”.
身體也會提醒你。累了、緊繃了，或是肩膀不自覺地抬起來，都可能是值得留意的訊息。: The body reminds you too. Being tired, being tense, or your shoulders rising without your noticing can all be messages worth attending to.
我們試著把這三種聲音，當作不同來源的回報。它們都值得聽，但不一定每次都準確，也不: We try to treat these three kinds of voice as reports from different sources. All of them are worth hearing, but not every one is accurate every time, and you do not have to act on them right away.
治理層要做的，是先把它們聽完，再問一句：現在，是誰該上場？: What the steering layer does is hear them all out first, and then ask: right now, who should step in?
03 可以檢查的這一段：聽見 → 停一下 → 選擇: 03　The part we can check: hear → pause → choose
不代表一定要照著做。: does not mean you have to do what it says.
「面對什麼事情都不再讓恐懼走進駕駛艙」: “Whatever I face, I no longer let fear into the cockpit.”
「整合後的自己，是最好的戰友」: “The integrated self is the best ally.”
害怕的時候，不需要假裝自己不害怕。恐懼可以坐在車上，提醒你前面可能有危險。你可以: When you are afraid, you do not need to pretend you are not. Fear can ride in the car and warn you there may be danger ahead. You can hear it out, then look at the road in front of you and decide how to turn the wheel. The one holding the wheel is you.
關於聽見情緒、留意身體，以及為自己留一點選擇的空間，有幾項研究可以參考：: On hearing our emotions, noticing the body, and leaving ourselves a little room to choose, there are a few studies we can look to:
：研究比較了兩種面對情緒的習慣。一種是把情緒壓下來，不表現出來；另一種是換個角度: : One study compared two habits for dealing with emotions. One is to push the emotion down and not show it; the other is to look at it from a different angle and understand what happened anew. It found that people who habitually look at it anew have, overall, more positive emotion, and better relationships and life satisfaction; people who habitually suppress their emotions show the opposite tendency.
：一項實驗發現，面對不確定的選擇時，身體的反應可能影響直覺判斷。越能察覺自己心跳: : One experiment found that when facing an uncertain choice, bodily reactions can influence intuitive judgment. The better people could sense their own heartbeat, the stronger this influence. Sometimes it helps, and sometimes it can pull a judgment off course. So body signals are worth noticing, but you do not have to act on them directly.
先想好，卡住時可以做什麼: Decide beforehand what to do when stuck
：一篇統合分析整理了 94 項研究結果，發現事先想好「如果遇到某種情況，我就先做: : A meta-analysis pooled the results of 94 studies and found that deciding in advance, “if this situation comes up, I will first do this one thing”, makes it easier to act in the moment than simply telling yourself you will do it.
試著為感受取個名字: Try giving a feeling a name
：在世界觀 01 裡，我們提過這件事。有研究觀察到，當人為自己的感受命名時，大腦: : We mentioned this in Worldview 01. Research has observed that when people name their own feelings, activity in the brain regions linked to emotional reactions goes down.
「治理層」是我們理解自己的說法與信念；研究提供的，是關於情緒、身體訊號和事先準備: The “steering layer” is our way of understanding ourselves, and a belief; what research offers is a reference on emotions, on body signals, and on preparing a pause in advance. Research supports the part that can be observed, and is not used to prove our belief.

有些力量很熟悉，也很有用。: Some powers are familiar, and very useful.
只是用過頭時，可能讓其他聲音變得不容易聽見。: But used too much, they can make the other voices hard to hear.
12 語根，是每個人身上都有的 12 種力量。當這些力量運作得剛好，可以成為你的: The 12 Root Codes are 12 powers that everyone carries. When these powers work just right, they can be your strengths; but sometimes one power is too strong, and can make you overlook other needs.
用過頭時：別人的情緒一湧上來，你也跟著陷進去，慢慢分不清哪些是自己的感受。: when overused: the moment other people's emotions surge up, you sink into them too, and slowly cannot tell which feelings are your own.
用過頭時：接收到太多訊息，一時分不清哪些是直覺，哪些是擔心與不安。: when overused: you take in too much, and for a while cannot tell which parts are intuition and which are worry and unease.
用過頭時：一有想法就想立刻行動，還沒聽完其他意見，就已經往前衝了。: when overused: the moment an idea comes, you want to act on it at once, and you rush ahead before you have heard the other views.
這三種力量，都有它們珍貴的地方。我們不需要把它們關掉，只是練習在聲音很大的時候，: All three of these powers have something precious in them. We do not need to switch them off; we only practice leaving a little room for ourselves when the voices are loud.
先聽聽它想告訴你什麼，再決定，現在要讓哪一種力量帶你往前走。: Hear what it wants to tell you first, then decide which power to let carry you forward right now.
語根描述的是我們觀察到的運作傾向，不是用來定義一個人的標籤，也可能隨著狀態改變。: Root Codes describe tendencies in how we operate that we have observed; they are not labels used to define a person, and they may change with your state. Whether the 12 Root Codes can describe a person stably is still being validated.
想看看最近的自己，哪些力量比較常出現？語根測驗，約 5 分鐘 →: Curious which powers have been showing up most in you lately? The Root Code Test, about 5 minutes →
下次遇到一件讓你心裡很亂的事，可以先停三秒，輕輕問自己三句：: Next time something leaves your mind in a tangle, you can pause for three seconds first and gently ask yourself three questions:
身體現在怎樣？緊、熱、累，還是還好？: How is my body right now? Tight, hot, tired, or okay?
現在是誰在說話？擔心的你、生氣的你，還是想好好處理的你？: Who is speaking right now? The worried you, the angry you, or the you who wants to handle this well?
我真正想要事情變成怎樣？: What do I really want this to turn into?
問完，再開口。情緒可以在，方向盤在你手上。: Ask, and then speak. The emotions can be there; the wheel is in your hands.
如果願意，也可以先跟自己約好一句：「下次心裡一急，我就先停三秒。」: If you like, you can also make a promise to yourself in advance: “Next time I feel rushed inside, I will pause for three seconds first.”
不一定每次都記得，也不用每次都做到。想起來的時候，再試一次就好。: You will not remember every time, and you do not have to manage it every time. Whenever you remember, just try once more.
我們相信，心裡的每一個聲音，都可能有它想傳達的訊息。不需要急著否定，也不需要把哪: We believe every voice inside us may have a message it wants to convey. There is no need to rush to deny it, or to get rid of any voice.
我們相信，在這些聲音之間，可以慢慢練習長出一個做選擇的位置。那就是此時此地的你。: We believe that among these voices we can slowly practice growing a place from which to choose. That place is the you of this moment. This is how we understand ourselves; it is not a scientific conclusion, and it does not need everyone to agree.
心裡卡住時，先停三秒，再看看自己的反應有沒有不同：可以記下來，過幾天再回頭看。: When you feel stuck, pause for three seconds first and see whether your reaction is any different: you can write it down and look back a few days later.
身體疲累或緊繃的時候，自己的判斷有沒有跟著改變：可以從日常生活慢慢觀察。: Whether your judgment changes when your body is tired or tense: this can be observed slowly in daily life.
事先約好的那個停頓，有沒有隨著練習變得比較容易做到：可以試試看，不必急著得到答案: Whether the pause you agreed on in advance becomes easier to do with practice: you can try it, with no need to hurry to an answer.
